scope: Public/documented model-authoring families; not every private Eigen or AD-engine symbol.

families.contract: R-side shape, finite-value, index and sparse-representation contracts precede native access.
families.evidence: Original nine-model project covers vectors/matrices/integer indices; array/sparse family probes are separate.

families.contract: Flat parameter order and free dimension depend on declarations and map/random/profile construction.
families.evidence: Scalar/vector parameters executed in original likelihoods; array parameters executed in the separable family probe.

families.contract: Keep deterministic estimands, diagnostic readback and generative simulation distinct.
families.evidence: Original normal SIMULATE and multiple report/sdreport paths executed.

families.contract: Check the actual family parameterization, support and log-density flag; not every helper has the same conventions.
families.evidence: Normal/Poisson/censor original models executed; other listed families require their own native tests.

families.contract: Stable arithmetic does not change invalid domains or remove identifiability problems.
families.evidence: Original stable-mixture template passed independent value and full logit/mean/log-scale gradient oracles at logits -1000, -3, 0, 2 and 1000 with two finite-difference step sizes.

families.contract: Distinguish covariance from precision, normalization from penalty and proper from intrinsic fields.
families.evidence: MVNORM and GMRF compiled value/gradient equivalence passed against a dense oracle. UNSTRUCTURED_CORR remains explained but not claimed executed.

families.contract: Scale Jacobians and array-axis ordering are part of the statistical target.
families.evidence: AR1/SCALE passed in the original model; SCALE/VECSCALE have independent value/gradient oracles. SEPARABLE state, row/column correlation and log-scale gradients matched an independent dense Kronecker oracle at two step sizes.

families.contract: Avoid invalid arithmetic in candidate expressions and distinguish branch changes from mathematical nonsmoothness.
families.evidence: Censor data branch executed; CondExpGt parameter-crossing probe compiled and matched positive/negative value and gradient references.

families.contract: A correct first derivative does not establish higher-order latent-model support.
families.evidence: Original quartic atomic compiled under CppAD and matched analytic values, gradients and Hessians at three points. This does not qualify every custom atomic or framework.

families.contract: Separate arithmetic, compilation, process ownership, threading and experimental framework evidence.
families.evidence: Original CppAD/OpenMP model passed; TMBad/autopar and specialized debugging/factorization remain separate.
